name: Conformance: v2 storage tenant-isolation probe
description: Fixture for `v2-storage-cross-tenant-isolation.test.ts` (spec/v2/core/storage.md §Shared rules, tenant isolation). One node, `core.conformance.storage-probe` (conformance-RESERVED): a host maps it to a node that calls its OWN storage service for the run's tenant, the one `family` names (kvStorage | tableStorage | blobStorage | cache | vectorStore | searchIndex | sql | nosql), with the run's inputs, and nothing else. `action: write` stores `value` under `key` and completes with `outputs.result = { written: true, ref? }`; `action: read` completes with `outputs.result = { values, keys }`, every value and every key the family's tenant-isolated read operations return for `key` (and for `ref`, when given); `action: delete` removes it. A rejection fails the node with the rejection's code, unchanged. The per-family mapping is in conformance/fixtures.md §"The storage probe fixture". A host MUST NOT advertise this fixture unless it implements it for every storage family it advertises.
